options.label: Monthly-paid — paid every day of the month incl. rest days and holidays

options.breakdown: 293 ordinary working days + 12 regular holidays + 8 special days

divisors.alternates_note: Factor 305 instead of 313, or 253 instead of 261, when the 8 special (non-working) days are not paid.
divisors.nwpc_practice: NWPC's own press releases convert daily rates with factor 313 (e.g. ₱455 × 313 ÷ 12 = ₱11,868).

coverage.applies_to: All private-sector workers receiving the minimum wage, regardless of position, designation, status or method of payment (Handbook p. 6; WO NCR-28 Sec. 4).
coverage.exempt_bmbe: Duly registered Barangay Micro Business Enterprises with a Certificate of Authority (RA 10644) are not covered by the minimum wage law; their workers keep SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG coverage.
coverage.retail_service_le10: Retail/service establishments regularly employing not more than 10 workers, and establishments hit by calamities, may APPLY to the regional board within 75 days of the order's publication for a one-year exemption; it is not automatic. If denied, the increase is owed retroactively with 1% interest per month.
coverage.kasambahay: Domestic workers are covered by RA 10361 (Batas Kasambahay) with separate MONTHLY minimum wages set by the regional boards, not by these daily orders.
coverage.penalty: RA 8188 double indemnity: the unpaid difference is owed twice over, plus a fine of ₱25,000–₱100,000 and/or imprisonment.
